props.label: Message In A Bottle
props.shape: clear glass bottle tilted diagonally, pale blue-white glass with a tan cork and a rolled cream parchment tied with cord inside, normally lying on its side on sand or a tabletop

props.label: Pirate's Hook
props.shape: curved steel hook rising from a dark brown stitched leather cup, silver-grey and brown, normally standing upright resting on the cup's rim

props.label: Skull Signet Ring
props.shape: chunky silver band with a carved skull and crossbones bezel, grey and white metal, normally sitting upright on a flat surface or in a treasure pile

props.label: Parrot Feather
props.shape: slender tapered plume angled diagonally, red at the base fading to green and blue at the tip with a tan quill, normally lying flat on a desk or map

props.label: Treasure Map
props.shape: unrolled parchment with curled ends, tan and cream with brown dotted trail and X marks, normally lying flat and open on a table

props.label: Tricorn Hat
props.shape: wide three-cornered hat seen from the front, black felt with gold braid trim, normally sitting brim-down on a barrel, chest or post

props.label: Gold Doubloon
props.shape: round flat disc, bright gold with skull-and-crossbones and ship relief, lies face-up flat on a table or in a pile of coins

props.label: Brass Compass
props.shape: open clamshell pocket compass, brass case with cream dial and red needle, sits upright hinged-lid-open on a chart or desk

props.label: Spyglass
props.shape: long tapered telescope tube, brass with brown leather grip, rests lengthwise diagonally on a barrel or map table

props.label: Jeweled Dagger
props.shape: curved steel blade with ornate gold and gem-studded hilt, laid diagonally point-down on a chest lid or plank

props.label: Rum Bottle
props.shape: corked glass bottle, amber-brown with red wax seal and aged paper label, stands upright on a deck or tavern table

props.label: Cannonball
props.shape: solid sphere, dark grey pitted iron with pale highlight, rests on planks or stacked in a cannonball rack
